retry_policy.do_not_repeat: Do not repeat the official issuer page or exact retained 60-book population and do not poll TUSDUSDT for the same 17-bip level.
retry_policy.literal_trigger: Reopen on a material official TUSD redemption minimum fee timing access continuity or Binance listing withdrawal fee change; or with exact account-qualified issuer access exact Binance account fee and withdrawal network fee exact receiving-bank and wire costs plus an executable USDT-to-bank-USD comparator; or after an independently observed event-driven TUSD ask discount above 25 bips from a non-polling source, then freeze one finite-size book and require every same-unit cost before any state-changing authority.
